# Ship Gate fixture site

> A tiny site that proves every Ship Gate check runs end to end on a conforming build.

## Pages

- [About](https://example.com/about/): why the fixture exists
- [Contact](https://example.com/contact/): a contact form
- [الصفحة العربية](https://example.com/ar/): the right-to-left page

## Markdown

- [About, as Markdown](https://example.com/llms/about.md): the About page without the HTML
